_what: Official data series that stopped updating, with each source's last release date. Factual and dated only; the definition is printed on the page. The key point: where an official window went dark, the board switched to a still-current official source (the 'instead' field) — so the board's own numbers are not stale. 'gov:false' marks a non-government source (kept for completeness, labelled as such).
_rules: An entry needs: an official series this board uses or would use; a verifiable last-release date; a citation. A source leaves the list by publishing again. VoteHub's status is driven live by the approval connector (source_stalled_since); the rest are watched daily by connectors/frozen_check.py, which flags a probable resumption via a red run. Government dates verified 12 Aug 2026 (research trail in project docs 02/04).

sources.name: DoD public casualty report (casualty.pdf)
sources.note: Weekly PDF frozen ten days into the term; never extended to 2025–26 operations.
sources.instead: DCAS casualty database (live), the board's military-deaths source.

sources.name: ICE public enforcement dashboard
sources.note: Dashboard frozen shortly after the inauguration.
sources.instead: ICE's biweekly detention workbook (live), the board's ICE source.

sources.name: DHS OHSS monthly enforcement tables
sources.note: Final release carried data through Nov 2024; no release since.
sources.instead: CBP monthly encounters (live); OHSS was used only for the completed pre-2022 border backfill.

sources.name: DOJ clemency statistics
sources.instead: DOJ clemency grants pages (live), the board's clemency source.

sources.name: DOJ Capitol Breach (Jan 6) cases database
sources.note: Removed days after the inauguration; deleted with ~1,100 case press releases in May 2026. Third parties preserved archived copies.
sources.instead: No ongoing official series exists; the clemency card carries the Jan 6 record.

sources.name: State Dept monthly visa issuances
sources.instead: Not currently charted on the board (a candidate metric).

sources.name: ICE detainee death reporting (full scope)
sources.note: Not frozen but narrowed: deaths within 30 days of release are no longer reported (Directive 11003.6).
sources.instead: The in-custody deaths series (live) continues under the narrower rule; the board notes the change.

sources.name: VoteHub approval poll feed
sources.note: Non-government source (a poll aggregator): no new national approval polls ingested since late June.
sources.instead: Disclosed on the approval card; the pipeline checks daily and the card revives automatically when polls resume.
